title: checkered sophisticated backpacks++
description: adds checkered pattern to your backpacks + tanks visually bigger, battery is longer in the side by side way and thinner in the front and back way + gage is longer and a little more Precise.
body:
**⚠️this resourcepack needs these mods**

---
- **[✅sophisticated backpacks](https://modrinth.com/mod/sophisticated-backpacks)**
- **[✅sophisticated core](https://modrinth.com/mod/sophisticated-core)**
  
optional:
- **[✅sophisticated Emerald](https://modrinth.com/mod/sophisticated-backpackstorage-emerald-upgrade)**

---

**this pack adds/modifies**
- **❗ backpacks to have a checkered pattern to them**
- **❗ tanks visually bigger**
- **❗ battery now are longer on the side and thinner in the front**
- **❗ longer gage that gives you a little more Precise meserments**
- **❗ the upgrades and ui look like componints.**
